KIRAN SANJAY GAIKWAD Senior Associate – Capital Markets Operations

kirangaikwadkg1@gmail.com | 9834994060 | Pune, Maharashtra, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Capital Markets Operations professional of experience across Trade Processing, Settlements, Reconciliation, Exception Management, Risk & Controls, and Client Service. Proven ability to manage end-to-end trade lifecycle activities across US brokerage and wealth management environments, resolve complex operational exceptions, handle client escalations, and lead teams toward operational excellence. Adept at stakeholder management, root cause analysis, process improvement, and driving automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Associate / Operations Specialist | State Street Pvt. Ltd., Pune – Hinjewadi June 2022 – May 2026

Trade Processing & Settlements • Managed end-to-end trade processing and settlement activities across a broad range of capital market

products.

Processed and monitored settlements through Euroclear, Clearstream, and Depository Trust Company (DTC)

platforms, ensuring compliance with market deadlines and settlement requirements.

Supported ETD (Electronic Trade Delivery) trade processing and settlement activities, ensuring accurate trade

capture, reconciliation, and lifecycle event management.

Investigated and resolved cash, position, and settlement breaks within defined SLA timelines, preventing

downstream risk.

Acted as primary escalation point for complex trade and reconciliation issues, coordinating resolution with

brokers, custodians, and counterparties.

Utilised GTM, MCH, eHorizon, and IMT for trade lifecycle management, ensuring accurate and timely

settlement.

Supported client queries and delivered high-quality service to institutional clients, maintaining zero major

escalations.

Reconciliation & Risk Controls • Performed daily reconciliation using Matching Utility (MU), TXR, Reverse Recon, ACAT, and Non-ACAT reports. • Monitored operational risk, ensured adherence to internal controls, and maintained compliance with

regulatory requirements.

Prepared management reports, KPI/KRI metrics, and operational dashboards to support senior management

decision-making.

Conducted root cause analysis on recurring breaks and implemented corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

Leadership & Team Management • Served as Acting Team Lead; managed daily workflow allocation, monitored team productivity, and ensured

adherence to SLAs and KRIs.

Provided coaching, mentoring, and structured training to new and existing team members, improving

operational accuracy.

Managed escalations from clients and senior stakeholders, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution. • Led process improvement and automation initiatives across reconciliation and settlement workflows, reducing manual effort and operational risk.

Supported business change programmes and implementation of new operational controls.

Senior Transaction Processing Officer – Cost Basis Operations | Mphasis Pvt. Ltd., Pune – Kharadi

August 2014 – June 2022

Operations & Processing • Managed end-to-end Cost Basis Operations for US brokerage and wealth management clients, ensuring

accurate asset transfer and tax reporting.

Processed Transfer of Assets (TOA), Mutual Fund transactions, Account Transfers, and DOD (Date of Death)

valuations within strict SLA requirements.

Conducted account, cash, and position reconciliations to ensure data integrity across multiple platforms. • Investigated and resolved complex cost basis discrepancies, missing securities, transfer issues, and non- confirming transactions.

Collaborated with brokerage firms, custodians, transfer agents, and internal teams to resolve operational

exceptions.

Supported corporate action processing — including mergers, acquisitions, and stock splits — ensuring accurate

cost basis adjustments.

Performed detailed quality checks and risk assessments to maintain regulatory compliance and operational

accuracy.

Subject Matter Expertise & Leadership • Acted as SME for Cost Basis Operations; supported team members on complex transactions and exception

resolution.

Assisted Team Leads in workload allocation, queue management, and daily operational planning. • Mentored and trained new hires on TOA processing, cost basis calculations, reconciliation procedures, and risk controls.

Contributed to SOP creation, process documentation, and knowledge management activities. • Participated in transition, migration, and process enhancement projects to improve operational efficiency.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Trade Processing & Settlement

Exception & Break Management • Client Service & Escalation Handling • Team Leadership & Mentoring

GTM | MCH | eHorizon | IMT

Reconciliation (MU, TXR, Reverse Recon) • Operational Risk & Controls • Euroclear Settlement Operations • Process Improvement & STP Optimization • Cost Basis Operations

ACAT / Non-ACAT Operations

KPI / KRI Monitoring & Reporting • Root Cause Analysis • Clearstream Settlement Operations

DTC Settlement Processing

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Dnyansagar Institute of Management & Research, Pune (2014–2017)

Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) – Mahatma Phule College, Pune (2010–2013)

Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) - Nav Maharashtra Vidyalaya, Pune (2007-2008)

Secondary School Certificate (SSC) - Nav Maharashtra Vidyalaya, Pune (2008-2010)

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Spirit of Winning Award – Recognised for exceptional ownership and commitment to operational excellence. • Resolved critical trade breaks before NAV deadlines, consistently ensuring client satisfaction under high- pressure conditions.

Maintained high accuracy in trade processing, minimising settlement failures and operational risk across

institutional client portfolios.

Managed high-value institutional client relationships with zero major escalations throughout tenure.

LANGUAGES

English • Hindi • Marathi

Declaration

I confirm that above stated information is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

Kiran Sanjay Gaikwad

Pune
